Enter a value between 0.1 and 500 km/h
Select a point on the map first
Choose AnyWhare as the mock location app in Developer options
Coordinates out of range (lat -90 to 90, lon -180 to 180)
Android only lets the app selected under Developer options, Select mock location app, simulate locations. Enable them (tap the build number 7 times) and choose AnyWhare.
Precise location: required to run the foreground location service.
Approximate location: Android requests it together with the precise one.
Mock location: allows publishing test positions once you pick the app in Developer options.
Foreground service: keeps the simulation alive with the screen off.
Notifications: shows the mandatory service notice and the Stop button.
Internet: only used to download map tiles and search places.
AnyWhare does NOT collect, track, store or sell any personal or location data. There are no accounts, analytics or ads. Settings (theme and welcome dialog) are kept on your device only.

OpenStreetMap (map tiles) and Nominatim (place search) receive standard HTTPS requests anonymously: no user identifiers and no tracking cookies. As with any web request, your IP address is visible to them and governed by their privacy policy. Only the text you search and the tiles you view are sent.
